title: An unread repo reads neutral: tri-state DECISIONS chip and a 'Not seen in public repos' pipeline evidence label
deviations_from_card: (1) The helpers first landed as two new modules (DevEvalPanelProcessTrace.chip.ts, pipelineGithubEvidence.ts). Measured on the committed tree alone, that took app/page.tsx from 1400 to 1402 modules, over its ceiling. 79632a9d3 moved decisionsLogChip into DevHelpers.ts and GITHUB_NOT_SEEN_* / notSeenInPublicRepos into PipelineCandidateDrawerTypes.ts. Both modules were already on the graph, so the page is back to 1400 / 8801 KB and perf-budget.json was not touched. The test files keep the component-named filenames in the same folders. (2) A decisionsLogPresent that is undefined (field missing from the bundle) also renders as the neutral 'could not read' chip, because it is no evidence of absence either. Only false is coral. (3) Both docs were updated: candidates/README.md, named in the prompt for the pipeline card, and dev-case/README.md, the doc-map doc for devcases, where card A had logged the chip as 'Still open'. (4) The old pipeline.drawer.githubUnverified key was deleted from all four catalogs in a separate lock commit that came after the component stopped reading it. The new keys went in first, so every commit typechecks. (5) The not-seen list leaves out any skill that the same review evidenced (compared case-insensitively). It does not import the skill-ledger taxonomy, to keep github-evidence.ts off the drawer's graph.
notes: Acceptance 11 of 11 (was 0 of 11). Both test files failed to load before because the helpers did not exist. Chip: true shows 'kept' in moss, false shows 'missing' in coral, and null or undefined shows the neutral 'could not read' chip (bg-paper text-steel) with a decisionsLogUnreadTitle tooltip. Pipeline card: the list is headed 'Not seen in public repos:' in text-steel, with a tooltip saying public work can confirm a skill but never rule one out. A per-locale test bans 'unverified'/'claim' wording, and a source pin forbids githubUnverified and text-amber in the card. New catalog keys: devcase.processTrace.decisionsLogUnread(+Title) and pipeline.drawer.githubNotSeen(+Title), with real cs/de/fr translations and no em dashes. tsc: 0 errors outside the untracked kpi-sim/ tree. One kpi-sim snapshot copy of PipelineGithubEvidenceCard.tsx now also errors on the dropped key; that tree is untracked and foreign. Earlier runs also showed errors in a sibling's untracked DecisionsUndoStrip.tsx and reset-route.test.ts, and those had cleared by the last run. Full test:unit exits 1 only on the known python-runner-concurrency FLAKE (it passed on re-run and is not mine). An earlier run's BROKEN tenant-keys.test.ts is a sibling's untracked file. test:perf: the committed tree (HEAD, checked in a clean worktree) is inside every ceiling. The shared working tree's page.tsx overage (1404) comes only from siblings' uncommitted decisions/ files. The panel was not checked visually in either theme (no dev server per the brief). It uses tokens only: moss, coral, paper, steel.
